'''Mameris''' is a place [[Birgitte]] remembers from one of her former life. It existed some time during the [[Third Age]], and was the center of a pacifistic movement, coupled with bluntly saying what one believed at any given time.<ref name="comp">''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]'', Mameris.</ref>
